content.text:
else:
        S.total = total_snap
    emit(S, ev, pk, 'error', code, at, fidx)
    terminate(S, 'closed', code, at, ev, pk, fidx, None)


def handle_packet(S, ev, pk, pkt, at):
    lvl, pn, auth, frames = pkt
    if S.terminated:
        emit(S, ev, pk, 'dropped', 'CONNECTION_CLOSED', at, None)
        return
    if not auth:
        emit(S, ev, pk, 'dropped', 'AUTH', at, None)
        return
    sp = SPACE[lvl]
    if pn in S.pn[sp]:
        emit(S, ev, pk, 'duplicate', 'DUPLICATE', at, None)
        return
    n = len(frames)
    if n == 0:
        emit(S, ev, pk, 'error', 'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR', at, None)
        terminate(S, 'closed', 'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR', at, ev, pk, None, None)
        return
    bit = LEVEL_BIT[lvl]
    for i in range(n):
        ft = frames[i][0]
        if ft == F_UNK:
            emit(S, ev, pk, 'error', 'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR', at, i)
            terminate(S, 'closed', 'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR', at, ev, pk, i, None)
            return
        if ft == F_CLOSE:
            if frames[i][1] and not (bit & APP_CLOSE_BIT):
                emit(S, ev, pk, 'error', 'PROTOCOL_VIOLATION', at, i)
                terminate(S, 'closed', 'PROTOCOL_VIOLATION', at, ev, pk, i, None)
                return
        elif not (ALLOW[ft] & bit):
            emit(S, ev, pk, 'error', 'PROTOCOL_VIOLATION', at, i)
            terminate(S, 'closed', 'PROTOCOL_VIOLATION', at, ev, pk, i, None)
            return

    undo = []
    touched = set()
    total_snap = S.total
    close_frame = -1
    close_app = False
    close_code = 0
    for i in range(n):
        f = frames[i]
        ft = f[0]
        if ft == F_STREAM:
            err = do_stream(S, f, undo, touched)
        elif ft == F_CRYPTO:
            err = do_crypto(S, lvl, f, undo, touched)
        elif ft == F_ACK:
            err = do_ack(S, lvl, f[1])
        elif ft == F_RESET:
            err = do_reset(S, f, undo, touched)
        elif ft == F_STOP:
            err = do_stop(S, f, undo, touched)
        elif ft == F_CLOSE:
            close_frame = i
            close_app = f[1]
            close_code = f[2]
            break
        else:
            err = None
        if err is not None:
            fail_packet(S, ev, pk, err, i, at, undo, total_snap)
            return
    # commit
    S.pn[sp].add(pn)
    S.last_act = at
    emit(S, ev, pk, 'accepted', 'OK', at, None)
    if close_frame >= 0:
        code = 'PEER_APPLICATION_CLOSE' if close_app else 'PEER_TRANSPORT_CLOSE'
        terminate(S, 'closed', code, at, ev, pk, close_frame, close_code)


def drain(S, level, at):
    sel = [e for e in S.pending if e[3] == level]
    if not sel:
        return
    S.pending = [e for e in S.pending if e[3] != level]
    S.inflight = sel
    S.inflight_pos = 0
    for i in range(len(sel)):
        if S.terminated:
            break
        S.inflight_pos = i + 1
        e = sel[i]
        handle_packet(S, e[1], e[2], e[4], at)
    S.inflight = []
    S.inflight_pos = 0


def run_trace(tid, cfg, events):
    S = State(cfg)
    early = cfg.early
    idle_ms = cfg.idle_ms
    for ev in range(len(events)):
        e = events[ev]
        op = e[0]
        t = e[1]
        if not S.terminated and idle_ms and t >= S.last_act + idle_ms:
            deadline = S.last_act + idle_ms
            terminate(S, 'idle', 'IDLE_TIMEOUT', deadline, ev, None, None, None)
        if S.terminated:
            if op == _OP_DGRAM:
                for pk in range(len(e[3])):
                    emit(S, ev, pk, 'dropped', 'CONNECTION_CLOSED', t, None)
            continue
